scenes.title: Where and when
narration: Daggering emerged in Jamaica's dancehall scene and was named around 2006.
The term describes a style of dance involving sexually explicit, simulated intercourse movements.
It has roots in longstanding dancehall practices but gained distinct identity and popularity through music videos and artists promoting the style.

scenes.title: When it is danced
narration: Daggering is a social dance performed in dancehall parties and music video contexts.
It is a form of erotic dance expressing sexuality and energy.
The dance is controversial and banned from Jamaican broadcast media due to explicit content and health concerns.
Today it is a living tradition.
